title: P-auth3: canChangeOwnRole uses first match; role 0 denies
description: room-policy-04 §8.1.3 'first non-zero role' for canChangeOwnRole. Readings: (a) take the first matching preauth entry and deny if its role is 0; (b) skip zero-role entries. Chosen: (a), matching §4 'receives the first role which matches' and keeping a zero-role entry usable as a deny rule.
